Title: Azure Logic Apps—Connector for Workday Human Capital Management

Body.Content:
Azure Logic Apps will help customers connect apps, data, and devices anywhere—on premises or in the cloud. The new Logic Apps connector for Workday Human Capital Management will make it easy to create workflows to manage important HR tasks. For example, when an employee record is created or updated in Workday, use Logic Apps to initiate multiple actions based on that event. You could specify actions to:

·        Provision an Azure Active Directory credential.

·        Send an approval request for a new computer to the employee's manager.

·        Create a Service Now ticket to fulfill the computer request.

 

All of this can be done simply by using the visual designer in Logic Apps. 

Learn more.
